title: GC runner frame selection: isolated test-infrastructure repair
scope: Only the project GC test adapter and its typed helper. No production source or dependency changes.
finding: The installed @vitest/browser-playwright 5.0.5 provider accepts the first arbitrary frameattached when named vitest-iframe is absent. Controlled real private frames reproduce selection of the wrong frame, false success, and FrameDetached after removal.
repair: Select the outer page actual iframe[data-vitest="true"] DOM element, obtain contentFrame, await ElementHandle.dispose, then retain the original one page.requestGC followed by same-target evaluate.
preservedContracts: Existing three GC calls per lifetime test, existing assertions/timeouts/retries/browser arguments unchanged.
A genuinely selected runner that detaches still raises the original FrameDetached error.
Missing runner does not succeed merely because a private frame attaches; it times out without requesting GC.
causalLimit: This establishes and fixes an independently reproducible provider-fallback exposure in the project test tool. The security 20:53 failure and issue #650 failure had no recorded frame identity; their actual causes and general GC stability are NOT established by these controls or passing suites.

repairControls.variants: Five scenarios, original versus candidate, each with a real isolated browser context.
repairControls.handleRelease: Every candidate selected-runner scenario creates/disposes one real helper ElementHandle before its sole native GC request.
repairControls.realRunnerRemoval: Both original and candidate retain FrameDetached failure after one GC.
repairControls.independentIdentity: Selected object identity compared with actual runner DOM ElementHandle.contentFrame, with control handles also disposed.

rawFailuresPreserved: Initial CommonJS dynamic-import harness TypeError before any browser launch; corrected harness and original preparation bytes retained.
Original wrong-private-frame FrameDetached stacks and private-only false success.
Genuine selected-runner removal failures for both variants.
Preliminary missing .d.mts type diagnostic is explicitly marked a tool-transcript-derived record, not an original full raw log.
evidence.temporalIndex: Original provider prepared-sha256-index.json describes pre-run input. Its old probe bytes are preserved in initial-import-harness-error/probe.mjs; prepared-preservation.json and portable verification check that mapping.
evidence.inputVerification: All original source-index entries plus each index itself verified before packing; 284 repair measurement inputs unchanged at final check.

validation.packageConsumers: ESM/CJS/UMD and TypeScript4.9/current installed tarball consumers passed
validation.commands: Seven recorded commands exit0; unchanged original tests.
validation.boundary: These results belong to the exact f8d baseline candidate, not other active fixes or a combined future branch.

portableVerifier.needs: Python standard library only; no extraction, browser or network.

delivery: Evidence only; no commit, push, pull request or alert closure performed by this archive task.
